# Punkolink

> Punkolink (L7) is a layer-7 router that sits at the core of your network — run the binary yourself, or hand it to the team that operates it and steps in, in minutes, when something breaks.

## Services
- [L7 router deployment into your core](https://punkolink.com/service.html#l7-router-deployment): We set up and configure our router at the center of your network, wired to your real services and routes, handed over in working order. Measured in days.
- [Incident response](https://punkolink.com/service.html#incident-response): When something breaks, an engineer who already knows your system is in within minutes and acts mid-fire: reroutes around the failing node, isolates the segment, gracefully degrades the non-essential so the critical keeps running.
- [Readiness, maintained](https://punkolink.com/service.html#readiness-maintained): Between incidents we keep an up-to-date map of your infrastructure and a response plan that tracks your changes — so when something fails, the response is measured in minutes instead of starting from scratch.
- [Degradation monitoring](https://punkolink.com/service.html#degradation-monitoring): We watch your traffic and catch problems before they turn into downtime. The visible result: incidents that never reach your users.
- [Infrastructure & software work](https://punkolink.com/service.html#infrastructure-software-work): Correction, extension, and preparation of a system according to what it objectively requires — even where that means building less rather than more, never what deepens dependence on the provider.
- [Peak-load preparation](https://punkolink.com/service.html#peak-load-preparation): Before a season or a launch, we stress your system, find the weak points, and harden it — so the surge doesn't take you down at your most profitable moment.
- [Abuse protection](https://punkolink.com/service.html#abuse-protection): We absorb floods, bad bots, and abuse aimed at your services — with a human on it when things escalate. Honest about scale: within the bounds of your infrastructure.
- [Access management](https://punkolink.com/service.html#access-management): We bring order to who can reach what: roles, routes, and permissions configured so the right traffic reaches the right place — and kept current.
- [Cost audit](https://punkolink.com/service.html#cost-audit): We show you what's actually flowing through your infrastructure — including runaway automated and AI traffic — and catch cost and load anomalies before they run for months.
- [On-prem delivery of our software](https://punkolink.com/service.html#on-prem-delivery): Want to take the L7 router and run it yourself — we hand over our software to deploy on your side, with setup help and documentation. The tool without the on-call, for those who only need the tool.

## Docs
- [Overview](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#overview): What Punkolink L7 is, what it isn't, and where it sits in your stack.
- [Quickstart](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#quickstart): Get a Punkolink instance routing real traffic in under five minutes.
- [First Login](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#first-login): Securing the admin panel the first time you log in.
- [New Route](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#new-route): Adding your first route from the admin panel.
- [Servers](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#servers): Backends your router can forward traffic to.
- [Pools](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#pools): Reusable server groups routes target.
- [Roles](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#roles): Access policies routes can require.
- [Routes](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#routes): The routing table — method, path, target, and access, row by row.
- [Routers](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#routers): Switching between and managing isolated router instances.
- [Settings](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#settings): Account, appearance, and gateway configuration.
- [Cheat Sheet](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#cheat-sheet): The commands and config blocks you'll reach for most, in one place.
- [Alternatives](https://punkolink.com/docs.html#alternatives): Battle-tested open-source options, for when Punkolink isn't the right fit.
